items.title: Republican Donor, Trump Ally Criticizes $5,000 Payment Plan
items.summary: Joe Lonsdale—a Republican donor, Trump administration ally and co-founder of Palantir—criticized the president’s proposal to give $5,000 to American adults if the GOP keeps control of Congress. “For the record, I am hugely in favor of winning the midterms, and love much about this admin, but am strongly against bread and circus bribes,” Lonsdale, who co-hosted an event on the convention’s sidelines, wrote on social media on Wednesday night.
